Belgian Hands On Tech brings Chinese laser weeder to the Benelux

 03-08 | Smart farming | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Belgian company Hands On Tech is taking on the import of CyanForce laser weeders from China for the Benelux. The machine made its debut at the Belgian trade fair Foire de Libramont. Photo: Bart Parrein

Hands On Tech from Tubize (B.) is presenting a laser weeder from Chinese manufacturer CyanForce at the Belgian machinery fair Foire de Libramont. The Belgian company is taking on the import of the Chinese laser weeders for the Benelux.

Hands On Tech in Tubize (B.), known in Belgium as a dealer of GPS technology from the FJDynamics brand, is starting to import laser weeders from Chinese manufacturer CyanForce to the Benelux. At the Foire de Libramont trade fair, in the town of the same name, Libramont in Belgium, Hands On Tech is showing a prototype. It is a 2-metre-wide laser weeder that is mounted in the tractor linkage.

Available next growing season

Hands On Tech reports that the weed detection and laser treatment technology is already complete. Work is still being carried out on the final design as well as on certification. The importer will give a number of demonstrations with the prototype this year.

The final version is expected to be available at the end of this year or in early 2027. The CyanForce laser weeder will then be available in 6 different working widths ranging from 1.2 to 6 metres. The machines are developed in China and assembled in Belgium.

Read on below the photograph

The CyanForce laser weeder is carried in the linkage, with a generator mounted in the front linkage. The CyanForce will be available in working widths ranging from 1.2 to 6 metres. Photo: Hands On Tech1 hectare per hour

The laser weeder detects weeds and burns out the growing point of the weed plant with a laser beam. To do this, the Chinese manufacturer uses 150-watt CO2 lasers. The 6-metre-wide T600B version is equipped with 20 modules and destroys 12,000 weeds per minute. There is also an ‘Enterprise’ version with 30 modules on the same working width. This machine is capable of 18,000 plants per minute.

In practice, Hands On Tech expects the 6-metre-wide laser weeder to have a capacity of 1 hectare per hour. The required engine power is 75 kW (102 hp). The machine weighs 3 to 3.5 tonnes, depending on the version.

Suitable for use in vegetable growing and arable farming

According to Hands On Tech, the accuracy is 1 millimetre. Once the AI-based weed detection has been trained to recognise crops and weeds, the laser weeder can be used in a wide range of vegetable and arable crops. The importer does not yet want to name a gross price.

translationZh:
位于比利时图比兹的Hands On Tech公司，作为FJDynamics品牌GPS技术的经销商，开始从中国制造商CyanForce进口激光除草机至荷比卢地区。在比利时利布拉蒙同名的农机展上，Hands On Tech展示了一台样机。这是一台2米宽的激光除草机，悬挂在拖拉机后悬挂装置上。

**下个种植季可用**

Hands On Tech表示，杂草识别和激光处理技术已经完成。目前仍在进行最终设计以及认证工作。进口商今年将用样机进行多次演示。

最终版本预计将于今年年底或2027年初上市。届时CyanForce激光除草机将提供6种不同作业宽度，从1.2米到6米不等。该机器在中国研发，在比利时组装。

**每小时1公顷**

激光除草机通过识别杂草，用激光束烧毁杂草植株的生长点。为此，中国制造商采用150瓦CO2激光器。6米宽的T600B版本配备20个模块，每分钟可消灭12000株杂草。同一作业宽度还有配备30个模块的“Enterprise”版本，该机器每分钟可处理18000株植物。

在实践中，Hands On Tech预计6米宽的激光除草机作业效率为每小时1公顷。所需发动机功率为75千瓦（102马力）。根据版本不同，机器重量为3至3.5吨。

**适用于蔬菜种植和大田作物**

据Hands On Tech介绍，其精度可达1毫米。一旦基于AI的杂草识别系统经过训练能够区分作物和杂草，该激光除草机便可用于多种蔬菜和大田作物。进口商暂未公布总价。
